name: Trump in a Maze
revisionLabel: Update trap lethality and refine barrel jump mechanics
description: Create a 2D wall-based maze platformer story featuring Captain Trump and five named pirates (Marco Rubio, Pete Hegseth, JD Vance, Steve Witkopf, and Jared Kushner). The core gameplay is a single continuous run: Captain Trump starts the maze, navigates traps, and jumps over obstacles to reach the end (a ship/dock). When Captain Trump reaches the end, control instantly switches to the next pirate, using the same map mechanics to reach the same ship near Captain Trump. This continues pirate-by-pirate until the final pirate reaches the docked ship.
